title: The effects of prostaglandin E2 on the gene expression of human natural killer cells
description: Tumour immune escape is a major factor contributing to cancer progression and unresponsiveness to cancer therapies. Tumours can produce prostaglandin E2 (PGE2), an inflammatory mediator that directly acts on NK cells to inhibit anti-tumour immunity. However, it is unclear precisely how PGE2 influences NK cell tumour-restraining functions. Here, we investigated how treatment with PGE2 over 24 hours affects gene expression in human NK cells.

samples.title: CP2
samples.description: Protocols: Peripheral blood leukocyte cones from healthy human donors were acquired from the National blood service under ethics license REC 05/Q0401/108 (University of Manchester). Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) were purified by density gradient centrifugation using Ficoll-Paque (GE Healthcare; Life Sciences) and NK cells isolated by negative selection (NK cell isolation kit; Miltenyi Biotech). NK cells were cultured at 37⁰C and 5% CO₂ in Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle Medium (DMEM) medium (Sigma) containing 30% Ham’s F-12, 10% human serum (Sigma), 1% nonessential amino acids (Sigma), 1 mM sodium pyruvate (Sigma), 2 mM L-glutamine, 50 U/mL penicillin–streptomycin, and 50 μM 2-mercaptoethanol (Gibco) (NK cell clone medium). NK cells were also supplemented with 200 U/mL interleukin-2 (Roche) and rested for 6 days prior to experiments. To investigate the effects of PGE₂, NK cell cultures were additionally supplemented with 500 ng/mL synthetic PGE₂ (Sigma) 24 hours prior to cell harvesting and lysis. NK cells were cultured at 37⁰C and 5% CO₂ in Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle Medium (DMEM) medium (Sigma) containing 30% Ham’s F-12, 10% human serum (Sigma), 1% nonessential amino acids (Sigma), 1 mM sodium pyruvate (Sigma), 2 mM L-glutamine, 50 U/mL penicillin–streptomycin, and 50 μM 2-mercaptoethanol (Gibco) (NK cell clone medium). NK cells were also supplemented with 200 U/mL interleukin-2 (Roche) and rested for 6 days prior to experiments. After being rested for six days the NK cells were left untreated or supplemented with 500 ng/mL synthetic PGE₂ (Sigma) 24 hours prior to cell harvesting and lysis. NK cells were re-suspended in RLT buffer (RNeasy lysis buffer; Qiagen) containing 0.01% β-mercaptoethanol to lyse cells and stored at -80⁰C prior to RNA extraction. RNA was extracted from thawed samples using the RNeasy mini kit (Qiagen) as per the manufacturer’s instructions. mRNA libraries were prepared using the Illumina stranded mRNA prep kit.
